cohort: 100 antenatal women at Guru Gobind Singh Medical College and Hospital, Faridkot (Punjab) with gestational age between 34 and 41 weeks
finding: Oligohydramnios (AFI <= 5 cm) was significantly correlated with cesarean section for fetal distress and low birth weight babies.
birth_weight: Assessed, specifically low birth weight (<2.5 kg)
